backend/main.mo: Implements access-controlled user profiles and product management with metadata storage.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence reports linking features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists summarized descriptions of many frontend source files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, color variables, and dark mode rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading JS libraries and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling authentication, onboarding, product editing, and export view switching.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for entering and saving a user's name during initial setup.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: UI component displaying step-by-step instructions for using and exporting products.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: UI for downloading individual or all product bundles as PDF or ZIP, with error handling and status indicators.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: App-wide layout with header, footer, authentication display, and conditional export/instructions controls.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal that displays onboarding instructions using ExportInstructions and includes a close button.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Shows an iframe preview of a generated PDF blob or an alert if none is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Lists the expected ZIP file contents for a product, including templates, checklists, and prompts.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Editor for modifying product fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with generation controls.
Manages multiple products, auto-saves drafts, and triggers single or bulk product generation with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on authentication state and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication and status, including login, logout, and loading stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding modal visibility and persistence using localStorage, with helpers for auto‑open and marking instructions as seen.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps react-query hooks to fetch and save the current user's profile via an actor, including query state merging.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes and adds utility classes like smooth touch scrolling.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides helpers to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Contains static default product definitions including descriptions, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Provides helper functions to trigger browser downloads for blobs and files.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date-stamped filenames for PDFs and ZIPs, plus a bundle name for all products.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Generates bundles for multiple products sequentially and reports progress.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a product bundle by fetching its cover, generating a PDF, creating a ZIP, and returning metadata.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Loads, saves, and resets versioned product drafts from localStorage with version checking.
Uses jsPDF to create a multi-page PDF for a product, optionally including a cover image.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Creates a master ZIP containing individual product ZIPs and a consolidated README using JSZip.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP bundle using JSZip, adding the PDF, cover image, templates, checklists, prompts, and a generated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates README sections containing usage instructions and platform‑specific upload guides for Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product data, modules, prompts, templates, checklists, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project state, requirements, features, known issues, and context for a digital product generation app.
